newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine mortgage bank sale clears first hurdle.
newsitem.headline: Argentine mortgage bank sale clears first hurdle.

text.p: The privatization of Argentine mortgage lender Banco Hipotecario passed a first hurdle Wednesday by getting the approval of deputies in the the lower house of Congress's Finance and Budget Committee.

The sale of Hipotecario, with the largest assets of any Argentine bank at $4.31 billion, has met protest in the ruling Peronist Party and opposition since it was launched last September. Critics of the project wanted to preserve the bank's role in providing accessible home loans.
But the committee's Peronist majority ensured approval of a draft bill to sell 92 percent of Banco Hipotecario, with the remaining eight percent going to employees and the state.

The committee's draft divides the expected $3.0 billion revenue equally between central government and the provinces, except for $100 million for a Regional Fiduciary Fund for public works and social programs.
It requires the Banco Hipotecario's new owners to maintain the bank's home lending role all over Argentina, even in small towns and villages, for a minimum 10 years.
